body: cli/envkit takes typed options and returns typed results: no printing, no os.Exit, no cobra, no os.Environ. The cobra layer is a thin translator (flags in, envkit call, formatted output). Why: before this a Go program could only shell out to the binary. It also fixed a real API bug: providerkit.Deps.Printer was typed with an internal package, so an external program could not construct Deps and the embeddable-plugins story did not work. internal/{discover,report,textdiff,outfmt} became exported packages.
title: Every CLI operation is also an importable Go API (envkit)
